scientific_invariants.question: Does research-behavior specialization improve Qwen3-8B-Base on unseen research tasks while preserving useful general capabilities?
scientific_invariants.hypothesis_h1: The tuned 8B model will have higher macro-averaged structured validity and research-action accuracy than the untouched base on the frozen research benchmark.

general_capability_control.interpretation_limit: Keyword-based narrow regression guard; not a general-intelligence measure.

training_treatment.loss: causal language-model SFT over serialized research prompt plus expected JSON output; EOS appended by TRL

checkpoint_policy.resume: latest atomically marked, valid Trainer checkpoint

evaluation.research_prompt: Same frozen research_model.research_protocol.build_prompt protocol for base and tuned models; no tuned-only prompt or chat template.
evaluation.primary_success_rule: Both tuned-minus-base paired mean deltas must be positive and both two-sided 95% paired percentile-bootstrap confidence intervals must exclude zero.

bootstrap.undefined_metric_policy: pair only rows with the metric defined in both conditions

execution_backend_details.currently_preregistered_execution: Linux x86_64 NVIDIA CUDA with one BF16-capable A100 80 GB or H100 80 GB (planning profile; not measured)
execution_backend_details.amd_candidate: Linux x86_64, one AMD Instinct MI300X (gfx942), ROCm 7.14 / TheRock PyTorch wheel

permitted_recorded_backend_variations.scientific_effect: Not inherently a treatment change if the same pinned PyTorch version, model, quantization and training operations execute; kernel numerics and determinism can differ, so record runtime and qualify loss/finite updates.

Flash Attention is not required; default SDPA may select a backend-specific kernel. It can affect speed, numerical roundoff and memory, but not the declared objective or batch. Record the effective attention implementation.

Backend implementation may differ while retaining NF4, double quantization and BF16 compute. This is not presumed equivalent until the actual pinned load, backward, optimizer and checkpoint smoke passes.
Device placement and allocator are execution details; record device/HBM/peaks. The MI300X run remains one GPU with microbatch 1 and effective batch 16.
The optimizer family and configured name stay adamw_torch_fused. Different ROCm implementation can affect floating-point order; require a successful finite update and record actual optimizer class.

not_permitted_without_new_experiment_id: NF4 QLoRA to BF16 LoRA or another quantization/training method

change to base model or revision, tokenizer, data, benchmark, prompt, loss, target modules, rank, alpha, dropout, sequence length, effective batch, optimizer family, learning rate, scheduler, warmup, epochs/steps, seed, checkpoint selection, evaluation, metrics, or stopping rule
execution_backend_details.literal_amd_execution_classification: Not yet classified; hardware smoke is required before choosing CASE A, B, C or D. No AMD device/session/credits were visible in the local environment at preparation time.

validation_policy.required_before_smoke: scripts/validate_e014_invariants.py must verify all frozen file hashes, dataset/benchmark canonical content hashes, split hashes/counts, manifest/config equality and locked package versions.
validation_policy.mismatch_action: Stop without modifying frozen experiment artifacts or creating an AMD qualification run directory.
